incident_nov12.title: What went wrong on 12 Nov

events.label: Merge page/demo-ai-pod — rewrote shared menu on every page; SpaceX entry dropped
PR #9 — tracker JS / Status bleed fix
PR #11 — canonical site-menu.json + SpaceX menu restore
PR #12 — var G menu syntax fix

incident_nov12.why_no_conflict: Each HTML page keeps its own copy of the menu list. The Demo AI Pod update replaced that whole list everywhere. Git did not show a conflict because those were separate full-file edits, not two people editing the same menu file in one place.
